method: skill chrome-devtools-mcp:a11y-debugging. Kick build cloned to a scratch directory, 10 selectors in src/content/selectors.ts and 2 manifest entries repointed at selectors measured in RECON/native/live, built with vite + bundle-content, installed unpacked in the chrome-devtools MCP browser, opened on a live channel drawn from the directory (logged out, dark theme).

consoleIssues.errors: 7, all Twitch GraphQL unauthenticated or tracking fetch, none from the extension

translationText.why: background chain starts with rgba(83,252,24,0.06), a 6% green tint the probe treated as opaque; composited over the Twitch dark panel the text rgba(255,255,255,0.78) is about 9.9:1. Screenshot kick-build-on-twitch.png shows it readable.

retryButtons.why: opacity 0 until row hover, by design; contrast must be measured in the hovered state

defectsToCarry: chip overlaps the composer placeholder 'Send a message' (visible in kick-build-on-twitch.png): Kick's action-bar anchor heuristic does not exist on Twitch, the chip falls back inside the input box
kt-float-local is 21px tall, below the 24px WCAG 2.5.8 minimum
accent stays Kick green #53FC18 on Twitch purple chrome: art direction has to be redone, not ported
notMeasured: keyboard trap in the language menu on Twitch
